name: wsl-path-conversion
description: Pure Windows->WSL path conversion (E:\... -> /mnt/e/...) used for the bash cd and every JSON-RPC cwd/writable root parameter; rejects UNC / relative / already-POSIX inputs.
cardTemplate: Summarise the wsl-path-conversion domain: pure Windows->WSL path conversion for process and JSON-RPC workspace paths.
specRefs: WSL codex spawn switch (SATELLES_CODEX_RUNTIME=wsl) / cwd conversion (src/wsl-path.ts)
rationale: A deliberately isolated side-effect-free pure function called for process cwd and JSON-RPC cwd; a standalone domain.
